name: Saki
source: A mysterious silver-haired red-eyed girl who has lost her memory and told [url=/c14544]Yukito[/url] that he will die within one week and that he will bring misfortune to anyone near him. [spoiler]An alternate version of the real [url=/c61799]Saki[/url] — the protagonist's real sister who just got back from overseas[/spoiler].
